name: Yukimi Kaede
source:
Affiliation: Hazuki Private School 3rd year, Group B (Formerly: St. July Girls' School) / Former student council president
Favorite Food: [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Botamochi]Ohagi[/url]
Gift: Helios Garden (The ability to see through a person's heart and it is being deciphered like a flower's color. This enables her to know a person's condition)

Kaeda is the maid of the Windsor Family. She was the former Student Council President of Saint July Girls' School, after she stepped down, [url=/c10097]Sakura[/url] became the new president. She's a maid so she's really reliable and very skillful in everything she does. She claims to have mastered 1000 killer maid techniques. They are just various close combat skills, and in addition to her Helios Garden, it is so much simpler because she can also detect enemies with that Gift of hers, since she knows they would be hostile.

[From [url=http://visualnovelspam.blogspot.fi/2013/08/hyperhighspeedgenius-thoughts.html]Visual Novel Spam[/url]]
